summary: @servicetitan/va-mfe-loader preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip` into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a package-local `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript bundle using a rotating string-array decoder (`MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`) and hex-mangled identifiers; its filename does not correspond to the package's advertised purpose (a small React micro-frontend loader whose actual entry `dist/va-mfe-loader.js` is a small unobfuscated component). Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime purely to execute a heavily obfuscated sibling file at install time is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: the obfuscated bytes are executed outside the Node ecosystem's normal review path on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
